items.definition:
serving as an introduction; preliminary
This is an introductory course to computer science.

relating to Tibet or its people
Tibetan monks are known for their spiritual practices.

lacking strong features or characteristics
The food was bland and lacked seasoning.

hot and damp
The air was very humid before the storm.

resembling milk in color or consistency
The tea had a milky color after adding cream.

overdue
The library book is overdue.

easy to remember and appealing
That song has a really catchy tune.

Relating to the nose.
He spoke with a distinct nasal voice.

relating to Scandinavia
She enjoys Scandinavian design and furniture.

impossible to forget
It was an unforgettable experience.

willing to take risks or try new things
He has an adventurous spirit.

bad-tempered and irritable
He's always grumpy before his first cup of coffee.

causing trouble, difficulties, or discomfort
It was inconvenient to travel during rush hour.

relating to Morocco or its people
She enjoyed the Moroccan tea.

not married
She remained unmarried her whole life.

relating to diabetes; a person with diabetes
She follows a strict diabetic diet.

not perfect; flawed
Every human being is imperfect in some way.

Trembling or unstable
His voice was shaky with emotion.

relating to Chile or its people
She enjoyed the Chilean wine with her dinner.

awkward in movement or handling things
He's a bit clumsy and often trips over his own feet.

neatly and systematically arranged
Her desk was always very orderly.

More desirable or suitable
A quiet environment is preferable for studying.

strong and robust
The sturdy table could hold a lot of weight.

plump and rounded
The baby had chubby cheeks.

resembling cream in consistency or color
The soup had a rich, creamy texture.

I felt dizzy after spinning around too fast.

smooth and shiny

no longer fresh; unoriginal
The bread was stale after sitting out all night.

lacking courage

having a physical or mental disability
The building has ramps for handicapped access.

having the shape of a triangle
The road sign had a triangular shape.

telling or expressing the truth; honest
She gave a truthful account of what happened.

not observed or detected
He slipped out of the room unnoticed.

not handled, used, or eaten
The food on her plate remained untouched.

having ample space
The new apartment has a very spacious living room.

not true or false

feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness
The children's faces were joyful as they opened their presents.

larger than normal size

without shoes or socks
She walked barefoot on the sand, enjoying the warm beach.

Fabulous; excellent.
That dress looks absolutely fab on you!

Dark or depressing; sad.

full of or characterized by mist

having a tinge of red
The sky had a reddish glow at sunset.

very large

able to be managed or controlled

covered with trees

without stopping; continuous

hygienic; clean
It's important to maintain sanitary conditions in the kitchen.

having a sharp or sour taste
The lemon juice was very tart.

Designed to be held in the hand.
He bought a new handheld gaming device.

Relating to or made from herbs.

not pleasing or appealing to the eye or mind

showing love or warmth

a dark brownish-red color
She wore a beautiful maroon dress to the party.

covered in or containing oil
The fried food left an oily residue on the plate.

fussy; hard to please
My brother is very picky about what he eats.

relating to Taiwan or its people
She enjoys Taiwanese food.

floating in water; out of debt or difficulty

written by hand rather than typed or printed
The letter was handwritten and difficult to read.

full of intense and frantic activity
It was a hectic day at work with many meetings.

full of joy or happiness
It was a joyous occasion when they finally reunited.

full of smoke; tasting or smelling of smoke

not feeling or showing gratitude
It's ungrateful to complain after receiving such a generous gift.
